chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which he points to the battles (future events) and describes a faction of the people of misguidance.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الضَّلَالِ: The people of misguidance; a term for groups or individuals deviating from the truth.
key_terms.الْمَلَاحِمِ: The battles; specifically referring to major future conflicts in Islamic eschatology and history.

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali's sermon in Nahj al-Balagha describe regarding future events and misguidance?
ai.summary: This introductory note sets the stage for Imam Ali’s eschatological discourse in Nahj al-Balagha, linking the concept of 'al-Malahim' (major battles or conflicts) to the rise of deviant sects. It highlights the scholarly tradition of viewing these events not merely as military engagements but as spiritual trials where the characteristics of 'Ahl al-Dalal' (people of misguidance) are revealed through their deviation from the truth.
